author: kayanidev
title: Looking for Concept Artists and 3D Artists for game
content: 🍂WINGIN’ IT: TIME FLIES FALL RECRUITMENT IS OPEN! 🐣🎃 We’re expanding our team this fall! Wingin’ It: Time Flies is a stylized 3D adventure currently in active development, and as our world continues to grow, we’re looking for more artists, designers, and developers to join us in bringing it to life! OPEN ROLES • Concept Artist • UI Lead • Game Designers • Maya Riggers / Animation • Narrative Lead • 3D Artists This is a volunteer, portfolio-focused project where you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with a multidisciplinary game team, contribute directly to a playable project, and create work you can showcase in your portfolio. Whether you want to design environments, help shape gameplay, develop the world and its characters, or bring our birds to life, we’d love to hear from you! 💛 Interested in joining the flock?🐣 Scan the QR code to apply! Feel free to share this with any artists or developers who might be interested. ✨ #GameDev #IndieGame #GameDesign #3DArtist #ConceptArt

title: Hiring Digital Icon Artist / Illustrator
